The '''Thory sector'''<ref name="EAOC" /> was located in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Thory Prime system/Legends|Thory Prime system]], which was connected by [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] to the neighboring [[Corthenia sector/Legends|Corthenia]] and [[Dohu sector/Legends|Dohu sectors]].<ref name="EGtW" />

By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Thory [[Sector/Legends|sector]] bordered the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]] westward, the Corthenia sector northward, the [[Qiilura sector/Legends|Qiilura sector]] eastward, and the Dohu and [[Tiala sector/Legends|Tiala sectors]] southward.<ref name="Mid Rim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> Thory retained these borders by [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], when it constituted a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Thory sector was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''The Essential Atlas'', noted on the [[Jedi Council Forums]] of [[TheForce.net]] that the Thory Prime [[Star system/Legends|system]] was created for "bookkeeping purposes" so that the Thory sector would have at least one corresponding system.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|archivedate=20191013233754|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.}}</ref> In [[2011]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://web.archive.org/web/20120117150257/https://www.starwars.com/atlas/midrim/index.html Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim]," which placed it in grid square K-7.<ref name="MidRimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=atlas/midrim/index.html|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref>
